Eli: Heads-uptwo customers asked for an 'Optimize Advisor' (batching/caching/quant recs + eval alerts). Need to scope v0 for next sprint.

Priya: Recommend v0 = read-only recommender + eval-triggered alerts only. Acceptance: sample checks show improvements on 3/5 prompts; concordance threshold 0.92; p95 short-chat latency <200ms when suggestions shown.

Jonah: Technical: provide two quant tiers (safe=int8, aggressive=int4/QAT) and include risk_score + expected memory/latency delta. Batching hints via tiny DSL.

Marta: Suggest pilot FastForms (throughput-first). HealthEdge needs audit + KMS; delay auto-changes there.

Eli: Agree. Plan: ship v0 read-only advisor + alerts; pilot FastForms. Owners: Priya (PM), Jonah (eng), Marta (cust). If no objections by EOD I'll lock sprint card.
